name: What waterproofing methods are used for low threshold showers?

mainEntity.name: What waterproofing methods are used for low threshold showers?

acceptedAnswer.text: Effective waterproofing is critical for low threshold showers to prevent water damage to your home's structure. Common methods include liquid-applied membranes, sheet membranes, or cementitious coatings applied over a properly sloped subfloor. These barriers create a watertight seal beneath the tiles, preventing water from seeping into walls or subflooring. Proper integration with the drain and sealing of all seams and corners are essential components of a robust waterproofing system, ensuring durability and longevity.
